collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager is selling painted pebbles as lucky lavastone chips: expose it, or let people believe.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been trading little orange-painted pebbles, telling people they are lavastone chips that bring luck. (friend) has noticed the paint comes off in the rain. Some villagers are very happy with their pebbles. Some traded good fish for them. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) tells (subject), privately, that (friend.he/she) knows, and that the fish must be returned. (subject) is embarrassed, and does it, with apologies. Some of the villagers keep their pebbles anyway. They say they feel lucky.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) says nothing. The pebbles keep being traded. Then it rains hard, and every pebble in the village turns grey. (subject) has a very difficult week.
